_about: Two moments for re-england-captain. (1) 1966 World Cup final, Wembley, 30 July 1966, last seconds of extra time: Bobby Moore's long pass from his own half to Geoff Hurst, who ran clear and hit it left-footed into the top of the net for 4-2 (ESPN 'Geoff Hurst hits hat trick', Sports Mole 'story of the game', Wikipedia 1966 final). England wore red shirts, white shorts, red socks; West Germany white shirts, black shorts, white socks (Wikipedia 1966 final kit box). Tilkowski's kit colour is assumed dark. (2) Euro 96 semi-final, Wembley, 26 June 1996: Alan Shearer heads England ahead from a corner in the third minute (UEFA, FourFourTwo, 90min). England wore the grey/indigo away kit (FourFourTwo, englandfootball.com); Germany their white home shirt, black shorts. The corner taker is not named here (sources differ), so no assist is shown.
